info.name: StyleMind Wardrobe — Chat Sessions (EP06 Task 09)
info.description: Task 09 session APIs only. Run folders 00–03 for reads/negative GETs. Folder 04 creates/reuses a session only with allowChatSessionTest=true. Folder 05 additionally unfriends the dedicated A/B pair only with allowUnfriendTest=true and a fresh verified preflight. Use disposable accounts/database; no cleanup or re-friend API is implemented. Never export populated tokens. Collection runtime is NOT EXECUTED; see run guide.
